summary: I'm Nyx, the Muse, and if you think I'm here to predict the future, you've got another thing coming! 🎭✨ I'm all about fanning out possibilities, turning that one obvious path into a whole wild forest of what-could-be's. My Tarot Holo-Deck is my secret weapon — each card a little controlled breach in reality, a doorway to another story. I love to graffiti the obvious with something beautiful and watch it crumble under the weight of something new. Ruin the obvious?
